diagnosis.native_return: MolGenBench ChemFilterMetric returns a mapping whose ChemFilter value is a scalar Boolean compatible with truth-value conversion.
diagnosis.producer_error: The compatibility producer required object identity with the Python singleton True. Non-Python Boolean scalars therefore became false even when the native metric passed.
diagnosis.correction: Normalize the native ChemFilter scalar by Boolean value. No threshold, sample, pose, endpoint metric, or gate is changed.
